nodes.title: R0–R5 路线索引与选择逻辑
widgets_values:
index 0 = R0｜原生基准：VAE/Noise Mask
最快、依赖最少；用于基准或排障。

index 1 = R1｜Inpainting LLLite
日常局部替换，边缘和上下文更稳。

index 2 = R2｜LLLite + Differential（默认）
效果/性能平衡路线，优先从这里开始。

index 3 = R3｜Lineart + 双 LLLite + Differential
Anima 结构控制并联路线，适合姿态/轮廓约束。

index 4 = R4｜LanPaint 高质量大改
大遮罩、内容重构；更慢，不再叠加外层循环。

index 5 = R5｜双阶段高质量精修
Pass1 结构重建 → Pass2 低噪融合，最慢。

anima_inpaint_lab.default_route: index 2 = R2: Inpainting LLLite + Differential Diffusion

latent_map.0: VAEEncodeForInpaint (legacy; may gray-fill on Anima KSampler)

anima_inpaint_lab.traditional_controlnet: not connected: no verified Anima-compatible weights
anima_inpaint_lab.brushnet_boundary: SDXL-only image bridge; not connected to Anima MODEL
anima_inpaint_lab.lanpaint_widget_migration: inserted seed control_after_generate=fixed for current frontend
anima_inpaint_lab.aspect_rule: BBOX ratio preserved first; nearest 8-pixel latent-aligned pair selected
anima_inpaint_lab.redraw_diagnostic: check crop Preview and Mask_C Preview; white Mask_C area is replaced by R2/R0-R5 result
anima_inpaint_lab.shared_seed_semantics: one shared INT output linked to KSampler/LanPaint seed inputs for R0-R5 and both R5 passes

mask_polarity_options.invert: invert the active inpaint area; use when the screenshot shows outer white but the subject center is intended

anima_inpaint_lab.redraw_fix_evidence: V2.2.2 gray crop reproduced; live GPU IMC Queue produced new face/clothing content
anima_inpaint_lab.easy_seed_minus_one_note: easy seed backend range starts at 0; frontend randomize action provides per-queue randomness

multi_round.route_policy: use the currently selected R0-R5 route for every round

seed_mode.false: all rounds use the common seed
seed_mode.true: each round selects a different value from EasySeedList random

multi_round.all_routes_note: all-route mode saves all six results per round; only list item 0 is carried into the next serial round
